pages.title: Reading the chains
text: Every isotope in the mod is made, or found, by one of four things:
CORE: irradiate it in the reactor, as fuel or in a target rod.
PLANT: reprocess or separate it in a machine.
WAIT: it decays on its own.
A chain reads left to right: What -> (half-life) -> What. The half-life under a name is how long half of it takes to turn into the next. Y = years, d = days, h = hours, m = minutes.
Next: the routes, then the two natural series.

pages.title: Uranium to plutonium
text: Burnt fuel and depleted uranium blankets breed plutonium. PLANT: the reprocessing plant gives plutonium nuggets; with depleted uranium they make MOX. The Pu-241 that decays into Am-241 is what the isotope separator takes out as americium.

pages.title: Fission products
text: PLANT: the isotope separator takes out:
Both decay by beta and WAIT in the capsule, giving heat for an RTG. The caesium capsule is a strong gamma source; strontium is mostly bremsstrahlung. Carry neither.

pages.title: Cobalt, lithium, silicon
text: Use the finished rod in your hand: a cobalt-60 sample, 1,250 tritium samples or neutron-doped silicon, and an empty casing back.

pages.title: Thorium to U-233
text: In thorium fuel this happens inside the assembly. In a thorium rod (casing + 1 thorium ingot, 168 h) it makes one U-233 Ingot, 480 g: the driver of thorium fuel instead of enriched uranium. In the fabricator: 8, 12 or 19 U-233 and 4 thorium make a 2, 3 or 5 % assembly.

pages.title: Bismuth to polonium
text: Casing + 2 bismuth nuggets make the rod. The ingot is 82 mg of Po-210: 140 W per gram, an alpha emitter with almost no gamma, so it is safe to carry and good RTG fuel. It saturates: more time in the core adds nothing, and it halves every 138 days.

pages.title: Neptunium to plutonium-238
text: Depleted uranium rod, 240 h: 0.2 g of Np-237, at low yield. Casing + 8 neptunium ingots, 120 h: 0.28 g of Pu-238, 0.57 W per gram. Real Pu-238 starts from kilograms of reprocessed neptunium, so this is slow.

pages.title: Radium to actinium
text: Casing + 8 radium. 1 mg of Ac-227 per rod: 14.6 W per gram with its daughters, which are strong gamma sources. A tiny, hot, dangerous fuel.

pages.title: Thulium-170
text: Casing + 8 rare earth concentrate. 19 g of Tm-170 per rod, 11.5 W per gram: the most power of any ingot, and it is gone in a year. Its beta particles make bremsstrahlung, so it reads strongly when carried.

pages.title: The uranium series
text: This is why uranium ore gives radium and lead. Bismuth is only a companion in the veins.

pages.title: The thorium series
text: Why thorium ore gives lead and radium.
